config.title: Task Creation Tips
config.message: Use clear, actionable titles and provide detailed descriptions to help team members understand the task requirements.

items.title: Best Practices
items.content:
• Write specific, measurable task titles
• Break down complex tasks into smaller subtasks
• Set realistic deadlines
• Assign appropriate priority levels

items.title: Priority Guidelines
items.content:
• High: Urgent tasks requiring immediate attention
• Medium: Important tasks with flexible timelines
• Low: Tasks that can be completed when time permits
